title: The lids don't fit the rectangle size. Not even close, actually. Basically useless.
text:
The lids don't fit the rectangle size. Not even close, actually. Basically useless.. The lids they sent along with the Rectangle containers *do not fit them*. It's not even close. The size difference is noticeable, with the lids being slightly larger than the containers.

Interestingly, they do fit a couple of the old Glad containers we've already had for years, so it would appear that they sent us lids for a different SKU or something.
